claim: Try the five-file sample without saving it with your local survey
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed a private real IndexedDB survey; open /demo; assert only five sample routes and reset

claim: A proposed route moves only after you check it
sandbox: fresh /demo; assert all sample approvals are unchecked; check one and assert the count

claim: Bulk approval changes only displayed rows
sandbox: 101-file read-only preview; approve displayed 100; reveal row 101 and assert it remains unchecked

claim: Your approval and destination edits survive a reload on this device
sandbox: fresh real sample; edit approval, bucket, and name; reload; assert all three values

claim: An imported undo receipt stays available to export after undo
sandbox: seed an imported-style receipt with no plan rows; reload; assert receipt heading and JSON/CSV controls

claim: Undo never overwrites an existing original path and can be retried after you remove that blocker
sandbox: in-memory filesystem; block original path, verify failed undo, remove blocker, and retry

claim: Sample file details stay in your browser
sandbox: fresh /demo; intercept every request during approval and edit; assert no third-party origin

claim: The app shell reloads offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; wait for service worker; go offline; reload the home screen

claim: File type and modified year determine the proposed destination
sandbox: deterministic file facts; assert extension classification and destination

claim: A move copies, verifies, avoids collisions, and can be undone
sandbox: in-memory filesystem; verify collision copy bytes, source removal, and undo restoration

claim: Receipts export as CSV
sandbox: manifest with quoted path and error; assert CSV header and escaped row

claim: Selected file details stay in this browser during preview, move, receipt export, and undo
sandbox: mock local directory; request log across choose, move, exports, and undo contains only same-origin requests

claim: Desktop folder choice is available when supported; other browsers can preview and export a plan
sandbox: feature-present and feature-absent browser contexts; assert chooser state, preview, and JSON download

claim: Demo, real survey, and Pro license storage use separate documented keys
sandbox: demo plus real sample and fixture license; enumerate IndexedDB and namespaced localStorage keys

claim: The product loads no analytics, third-party scripts, or CDN fonts
sandbox: request log across home, demo, privacy, and terms; assert every runtime request is same-origin

claim: Free runs show a 100-file move limit; a verified $19 Pro license removes it
sandbox: 101-file preview plus recorded valid license response; assert free cap message and unlocked Pro state

claim: Checkout and license verification use Sociobot
sandbox: assert checkout href and record fixture license verification request origin

claim: Triagebox asks for a folder only after you choose a folder
sandbox: picker spy; assert zero calls on load and one after Choose a folder

claim: Receipts record each file’s original timestamp
sandbox: fixture receipt; assert exact source timestamp in JSON data and CSV

claim: Triagebox lists files in nested folders with their relative paths
sandbox: nested in-memory directory; assert each file appears once with its full relative path
